lens: Design-token and accessibility engineer (DTCG, WCAG contrast maths, cascade layers)
reads: research/cedar-springs-teardown-blueprint.md (moved from the repo root at the seed commit)
deliverables: tokens.json: dark-first defaults ($extensions["ca.rnc.default"]:"dark"), light values under [data-theme=light]; C3 fluid type scale; glass minimum alphas; two-tone focus ring tokens; manifest colours as tokens
check-contrast.mjs: every text/surface and focus/surface pair in both themes, solid fallbacks, glass worst cases over the art-palette extremes from tokens-proposal.json

00-layers.css (layer order), 01-reset, 02-base, 03-type, 05-layout, 08-utilities, 95-motion.css (T0–T4 tiers, the only place besides tokens.css allowed to mention prefers-reduced-motion), 99-print.css
prefers-reduced-transparency, prefers-contrast: more and forced-colors rules; build.mjs reads manifest/theme colours from tokens
acceptance: A13#15: No loader; native View Transitions honouring reduced motion — verified by motion-audit#vt-and-loader
A12#6: Restraint: two-tone palette, big imagery, white space (superseded on aesthetics by the alive direction; hard constraints kept) — verified by f-visual#restraint-review (W4 screenshot matrix)
C3.1: Keep / adapt / drop (no loaders, sliders, lowercase source, third-party embeds) — verified by check-motion-policy#banned-effects
C3.2: Fluid type scale (display…small, Inter 400/600/700, Newsreader italic quotes only) — verified by unit/ds-core-tokens.test#type-scale
C3.3: Colour usage and contrast incl. dark focus token — verified by check-contrast#all-pairs
C3.5: Motion rules (transform/opacity, VT where supported, reduced motion, nothing autoplays) — verified by motion-audit#policy-tiers
P0#3: Dark-mode focus ring ≥ 3:1 on Fir night; re-test all focus states — verified by check-contrast#focus-pairs
P4#18: Glass limited to chrome, solid content, fluid type, reduced motion, no loaders/sliders/autoplay — superseded on aesthetics, hard constraints kept — verified by check-contrast#glass-worst-case
Every surface has ≥ 1 ring colour ≥ 3:1 and the two ring colours are ≥ 3:1 against each other
Without data-theme the page renders dark; [data-theme=light] renders light; no flash (HEAD_SCRIPT applies stored choice before paint)
gates: cd $WT/site && node tools/dev-setup.mjs --devtools   # once it exists (W1 build); before that: tsc --typeRoots /opt/node-tools/node_modules/@types
node build.mjs --offline-images --out=$OUT && SITE_DIST=$OUT node tools/check-all.mjs --no-build [--strict-redirects from W1 ia on]
PORT=$PORT SITE_DIST=$OUT node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --trace off
node tools/a11y.mjs --themes=dark,light --widths=320,1440 --motion=off,on   # once qa lands; until then axe via the global helper
verifierLens: Contrast mathematician: recompute every pair, test forced-colors and 200 % zoom, grep for stray prefers-reduced-motion
portRule: builder = port; reviewer = port + 10; fixer = port + 20; evidence collector 4400
returns: {branch, head, base, files, gates, acceptance[], requests[]}
requests: .orchestra/requests/ds-core.md (never edit a file outside owns; describe the change there)
